_comment: Hardware and deployment configuration for real robot pipeline
_vla_model_comment: pi05 uses joint_position (7D) and joint_velocity actions (8D). openvla-oft uses cartesian_position (6D) and cartesian_velocity actions (7D).

yoloe_visual_server._comment: YOLOE visual prompt server for visual reference mode

registration._comment: Low threshold for 3rd person view object detection during registration. right_mask_ratio: mask right portion of frame (0.2 = mask right 1/5)

random_erasing._comment: High threshold for wrist view distractor masking. max_mask_area_ratio: skip masking if mask covers more than this fraction of image. target_unmask_conf: low threshold for detecting target object to unmask

camera_intrinsics._comment: Camera intrinsic parameters (focal length, principal point)

camera_extrinsics._comment: Camera extrinsics [x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw] - camera pose in robot base frame. Update these after running calibration.

object_meshes._comment: Paths to object mesh files for FoundationPose

yoloe_prompts._comment: YOLOE text prompts for each object

registration._comment: Registration settings and debug save directory

vla_server._comment: Point to the IP address of the VLA policy server (e.g., GPU server)

motion_planning._comment: IK_MP uses blocking motion, no control_frequency needed. Perturbations for future retry logic.

above_pose._comment: Default height above object. object_specific is placeholder for future custom handling.

vla_execution._comment: gripper > 0.5 means open (0), gripper <= 0.5 means close (1). max_retries: skill-level retry attempts. post_skill_lift_distance: meters to lift EE after skill

success_checking._user_decide_mode_comment: If true, ask user y/n for success every user_decide_interval steps, starting from user_decide_start_step

object_lifted._comment: For pick skills: object Z increases by >= 3cm

object_on_target._comment: For place-on skills: XY < 5cm, Z < mesh_half_edge + 2cm

object_in_target._comment: For place-in skills: XY < 5cm, Z < 5cm (fixed threshold)

object_hang._comment: For hang skills: lifted >= 2cm, XY < 5cm, stable (< 2cm change) for 10 steps

full_pipeline_video._comment: Records entire pipeline (registration + motion planning + VLA) from both cameras

tracking._comment: Number of refinement iterations during tracking
